title: A project's code review config (docs/review.json)
description: Read by the review skill's file_review.py. The script checks a config against this schema and refuses one that doesn't match, naming the field. It knows the keywords used here: type, required, properties, additionalProperties, enum, pattern, minLength, minimum, items, uniqueItems.

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editors.

repo.description: The repository the issues and advisories are filed in, as owner/name.

prefix.description: Optional, "CR" when left out. The start of every review's name: prefix "CR" and the sweep label sweep:CR1 name the review CR1, its anchor, its steps CR1.1, its branch code-review-1 and its work pad review/1. The review's number comes from its sweep, never from this file.

area_prefix.description: The start of every area label, such as "area:". A finding's area label is this prefix and its area.

areas_command.description: Optional. A command that prints the project's areas, one name a line, without the prefix. Without it, the areas are the repository's labels that start with area_prefix.

labels.description: Optional. Labels added to every finding's issue.

kind_prefix.description: Optional. When set, each finding also gets the label <kind_prefix><kind>, such as "kind:bug". Without it, the kind is in the body only.

question_label.description: Optional, "question" when left out. The label of a question issue: open while it waits for the owner, closed once answered, and kept then.

refine_label.description: Optional, "refine" when left out. The label of a finding that can't be worked until the owner has decided something about it. It comes off when the decision is recorded.

dismiss_label.description: Optional, "dismiss" when left out. The label of a finding the work showed to be no defect: open, it is proposed for dismissal; closed by the owner, it is dismissed, and keeps the label.

schedule.description: Optional, "docs/remediation/{sweep}-schedule.json" when left out. Where a sweep's work schedule is kept (the review-triage skill), with {sweep} standing for the sweep's name, such as CR1.

unit_size.description: Optional, 20 when left out. The most findings a work unit of the schedule holds, unless the unit says why it holds more.

open_units.description: Optional, 3 when left out. The most work units open at once: started and not yet merged.

text_check.description: Optional. A command run on every title and body before it is posted, with {file} standing for a file that holds them. A non-zero exit stops the post.

advisory_package.description: Optional. The package a security advisory names. Without it: ecosystem "other" and the repository's name.
